text.en: Long-time clients and new visitors applaud the owner and groomers for their professionalism, warmth, and courteous customer service. Reviewers praise the salon's genuine dedication, noting that the team operates with patience, deep styling experience, and consistent attentiveness across appointments.

Customers praise the quality of haircuts, noting that dogs look dapper, well-proportioned, and smell delightful after their visits. Reviewers mention that styling matches instructions accurately, whether for energetic young puppies receiving their first haircut or long-time canine clients.

Pet owners emphasize the deep affection and patience shown toward all pets, especially seniors. A reviewer highlighted how lovingly a 17-year-old dog with hearing and vision loss was accommodated, noting that pets feel completely relaxed and secure in the hands of the groomers.

q.en: Can they accommodate very old or frail dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients emphasize that groomers show immense patience and gentle care when working with senior pets with sensory loss.

q.en: How do first-time puppies handle visits here?

a.en: Reviewers report that young puppies feel relaxed during their first grooming sessions and come home looking clean and happy.

q.en: How long have regular customers been using this salon?

a.en: Several reviewers mention bringing their dogs to Golden Paws consistently for five years or more.
